settings.restoreDefaultsMessage: User data and preferences will be removed.
settings.privacyOnDeviceBody: HydroFit.do stores your intake logs, profile, reminders, and preferences on this device. You do not need an account, and this version does not upload your health data to a HydroFit cloud.
settings.privacyAdsBody: HydroFit shows Google AdMob banners and occasional full-screen ads. Google may collect device identifiers for advertising. You can review or change consent with Ads & privacy in Settings.
settings.privacyControlBody: You can change reminder permissions in system settings, manage ad consent with Ads & privacy, and erase local data with Restore to defaults. HydroFit does not sell personal information.
settings.termsUseBody: HydroFit.do is a personal lifestyle companion for hydration habits. By using the app you agree to use it for your own tracking on this device.
settings.termsHealthBody: HydroFit does not diagnose, treat, or prevent disease. Daily targets are estimates from your weight and schedule. Talk to a qualified clinician about medical or fluid-restriction needs.
settings.termsDataBody: Features may change as the app evolves. Because HydroFit is offline-first, this version does not promise cloud backup or sync across devices.
settings.helpIntro: Quick answers for logging and reminders.
settings.helpStartBody: Use Home to log water, Plan to see your schedule, and Stats to review trends. Settings is where reminders, units, and language live.
settings.helpLogBody: Tap the log button on Home or add a record with a custom time. Choose a container size from Switch if you use a bottle or glass that is not 250 ml.
settings.helpRemindersBody: Reminders follow your wake and bed times. In Settings you can pick a sound, switch to vibration-only, or turn reminders off. HydroFit needs notification permission from Android.
settings.helpClimateBody: Climate bonuses are not used in this version. Daily goals stay at weight × 33 ml. Weather-aware targets are planned after MVP 1.
settings.helpAdsBody: A banner sits above the tab bar. Tips shows a closeable banner you can dismiss. Unlocking an achievement also shows a closeable banner, not a full-screen ad. A full-screen ad may appear after every third log of the day or when you first hit your daily goal — never on launch or on every tap.
settings.helpDataBody: Your logs stay on this device. Ads use Google device identifiers. Read Privacy Policy and Terms of Service in Settings for the full picture. Restore to defaults erases local HydroFit data.
settings.adsPrivacyIntro: How HydroFit shows ads and how you control consent.
settings.adsPrivacyWhatBody: A banner sits above the tab bar. Tips shows a closeable banner you can dismiss. Unlocking an achievement also shows a closeable banner, not a full-screen ad. A full-screen ad may appear after every third log of the day or when you first hit your daily goal.
settings.adsPrivacyWhenBody: Ads never appear on onboarding or on launch. Full-screen ads are skipped for timed entries from the log modal, and never show on every tap. Logging always succeeds even if an ad fails to load.
settings.adsPrivacyDataBody: HydroFit uses Google AdMob. Google may collect device identifiers for advertising. HydroFit does not sell your personal information, and your hydration logs stay on this device.
settings.adsPrivacyControlBody: Google may show advertising privacy choices where required (UMP). Read Privacy Policy and Help & Support for the full picture, or erase local data with Restore to defaults.

tips.title: Hydration Tips
tips.heroDescription: Thirst is a lagging indicator of dehydration. Sip consistently throughout your day to maintain peak focus and energy.
tips.empty: No tips found matching your search.
tips.morningFlushDescription: Drink 250–500ml soon after waking to replace overnight fluid loss and ease into your day.
tips.morningThirstLagDescription: Don't wait until you feel thirsty—sip early so focus and energy stay steady.
tips.morningUrineDescription: A pale yellow color usually means you're on track. Darker urine can be a cue to drink more.
tips.morningBeforeCoffeeDescription: Have a glass of water before your first coffee so caffeine isn't your only morning fluid.
tips.preWorkoutDescription: Sip 200–300ml about 15–30 minutes before exercise so you start primed, not catching up.
tips.duringWorkoutDescription: Small sips during training help maintain performance without a heavy stomach.
tips.postWorkoutDescription: After a sweaty session, replace fluids you lost—don't wait until you're home and exhausted.
tips.sweatReplaceDescription: Hot days and hard efforts raise fluid needs. Log extra water when you finish strong.
tips.eatWaterDescription: Cucumber, watermelon, oranges, and soups add fluids—snack and sip smart.
tips.beforeMealsDescription: A glass before eating is an easy habit that keeps intake steady across the day.
tips.caffeineBalanceDescription: Enjoy coffee or tea, then add water nearby so caffeine doesn't crowd out hydration.
tips.soupSmoothieDescription: Smoothies and broths contribute to your daily fluid total—log them if it helps you stay consistent.
tips.listenBodyDescription: Use your HydroFit target as a guide, then fine-tune based on how you feel and how active you are.
tips.deskGlassDescription: A visible bottle or glass is a quiet reminder—refill it once and you've already won the morning.
tips.streakCueDescription: You've built momentum. A small sip now keeps the chain alive and the habit automatic.
tips.eveningTaperDescription: Front-load fluids earlier so you're hydrated by evening without disrupting sleep.
tips.benefitReminderDescription: Steady hydration supports focus, energy, and recovery. One more glass still counts.
tips.earlyBirdBoostDescription: You already log water early—keep that edge by making the first glass non-negotiable.
